Alex: Heads-up: last-minute agenda tweak 
Alex: (ignore garbled chars) — sorry, re-post: Heads-up: last-minute agenda tweak — move customer story to after roadmap, add a 25s buffer to allow caption catch-up. Recorder had a 45s gap in rehearsal; need fallback confirm.
Nina: Copy. I can start a rolling local capture and flip the ingest to backup-node if encoder jitter appears.
InfraBot: ingest-monitor: observed 3% frame jitter on obs-node-7 in last 10m. Recommend backup-node-1.
Sam: I'll patch the slide notes and the MC script to announce the reorder. Also, flag top Qs for leadership: Dedicated pricing flexibility, Dedicated autoscaler timeline, and private deployment onboarding ETA. Prioritize pricing.
Mia (CEO): Good plan. We'll mention the reorder in kickoff and reserve ~6 minutes for pricing/commit questions during Q&A. Product, please have a PM on-standby for pricing specifics.
Nina: Starting fallback recorder now:
```
recorderctl start --session allhands-2026-04-12 --dest /var/recs/allhands-2026-04-12-fallback.mp4 --mode rolling
```
RecorderBot: Fallback recorder started (id: rec-5509)
Alex: Thanks. Also bump captions resync to happen immediately after the roadmap +5s.
Sam: Done. Slide 1 notes updated and deck v4 uploaded: https://drive.internal/allhands/deck-v4.pptx
Nina: Switching ingest to backup-node-1 now :white_check_mark:
InfraBot: ingest switched to backup-node-1 :white_check_mark:
Sam: I'll queue the customer story after roadmap and set a 25s stage buffer between slides to let captions settle.
Mia (CEO): We'll take the top 3 live Qs at the end. Also quick callout: Dedicated autoscaler listed as "designing (Q2)" on the roadmap slide.
Alex: OK going live in 2. If anyone sees audio/frame issues, post here and I'll cut to backup.
Nina: Feed stable, captions resynced. Recorder uploading after session and will attach to INF-801.
RecorderBot: upload queued: will post link when complete.
Sam: Post-meeting tasks: Nina attach raw recording + INF, Sam to export 8-10m highlight for marketing, Product to send pricing FAQ to Comms.
Mia (CEO): Thanks everyone for the quick swap. Good luck live.
Alex: Closing thread and switching to live channel. :thumbsup:
